title: Filter<T> derive macros may generate over-broad bounds
description: In crate-jmap-types/src/query.rs lines 27-34, Filter<T> derives Clone, PartialEq, Serialize, Deserialize. The derive macros for these traits generate bounds like T: Clone, T: PartialEq, T: Serialize, T: for<'de> Deserialize<'de> — which is correct and exactly what is needed. However, the derive for PartialEq on Filter<T> generates impl<T: PartialEq> PartialEq for Filter<T>, and the Clone derive generates impl<T: Clone> Clone for Filter<T>. These are appropriately tight bounds. No issue. One observation: if Eq is added (finding JMAP-u2e.1), the Eq derive will generate impl<T: Eq + PartialEq> Eq for Filter<T>, which is also correct. This finding is informational — no action needed; the bounds are correct as written.
